name: use-case-how-it-works
title: Use case how it works
description: Numbered implementation steps with install commands and code examples.
usage: The "how it works" section of a use case or product page. `UseCaseHowItWorks` keeps the install command and the code on one language; `UseCaseStepCards` for three or four steps that each carry an example, with outline pills to the APIs under them. `UseCaseCodeTabs` is the tabbed code window on its own (`label`, `actions`, `showInstall` for the install footer); `UseCaseSectionLinks` closes a section with outline pills (the site uses it under the steps and, as "Guides for this workflow", under the demo). Every code window and install command on a page follows one remembered language (useCodeLanguage).
avoid: Full syntax themes in the code (Context.dev's light highlighting only)
More than four step cards in a row
An arrow that moves on hover in the section links
A language picker that only changes one window on the page

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
